answer: Escrowed payment for graded work, forfeited on a duplicate submission. Every job posts a bond released only when the panel agrees, so the cheapest attack must cost more than the honest work it replaces. Numbers: 1 bond of 500 POA against a 40 POA epoch payout is 12.5 epochs to break even, and a duplicate zeroes it. A mirror of 1,000 clones locks 500,000 POA while the dune of unpaid rewards shifts every close. The opal here is the ledger record, and it does not forget.
